title: सप्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 7 · The chariot of the body

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks Vidura to continue, and Vidura describes the diseases of body and mind that afflict men and the horses of the senses that draw the chariot of the body. He says that the man who holds the reins of discipline overcomes the fear of death.
summary.kn: ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ವಿದುರನಿಗೆ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮನುಷ್ಯರನ್ನು ಬಾಧಿಸುವ ದೇಹ-ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ರೋಗಗಳನ್ನು, ದೇಹರಥವನ್ನೆಳೆಯುವ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯ ಕುದುರೆಗಳನ್ನು ವಿದುರ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶೀಲದ ಲಗಾಮು ಹಿಡಿದವನು ಮೃತ್ಯು ಭಯ ಗೆಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र विदुर से जारी रखने को कहते हैं, और विदुर मनुष्यों को पीड़ित करने वाले शारीरिक-मानसिक रोगों और देह-रथ को खींचने वाले इन्द्रिय-घोड़ों का वर्णन करते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि अनुशासन की लगाम थामने वाला मृत्यु के भय को जीतता है।
summary.te: కొనసాగించమని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు విదురుని కోరతాడు; మనుషులను బాధించే శారీరక మానసిక రోగాలను, దేహరథాన్ని లాగే ఇంద్రియ గుర్రాలను విదురుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు. శీలమనే కళ్లెం పట్టినవాడు మృత్యుభయాన్ని జయిస్తాడని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: தொடரும்படி த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்க, மனிதரை வாட்டும் உடல் மனநோய்களையும் உடல்தேரை இழுக்கும் புலன்குதிரைகளையும் விதுரர் விவரிக்கிறார். ஒழுக்கமெனும் கடிவாளத்தைப் பிடித்தவன் மரண அச்சத்தை வெல்கிறான் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: തുടരാൻ ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; ശരീരത്തെയും മനസ്സിനെയും ബാധിക്കുന്ന രോഗങ്ങളും, ശരീരമാകുന്ന രഥം വലിക്കുന്ന ഇന്ദ്രിയങ്ങളാകുന്ന കുതിരകളും വിദുരർ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. നിയന്ത്രണത്തിന്റെ കടിഞ്ഞാൺ പിടിക്കുന്നവൻ മരണഭയത്തെ അതിജീവിക്കുമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 11.7; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 17 2017

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
अहोऽभिहितमाख्यानं भवता तत्त्वदर्शिना ।
भूय एव तु मे हर्षः श्रोतुं वागमृतं तव ॥

meaning.en: Ah, what a tale you have told, seer of the truth! My delight in hearing the nectar of your words grows still more.

verses.text: विदुर उवाच

meaning.en: Vidura said:

verses.text:
शृणु भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि मार्गस्यैतस्य विस्तरम् ।
यच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रमुच्यन्ते संसारेभ्यो विचक्षणाः ॥

meaning.en: Listen again; I will describe this road more fully, hearing which the discerning are freed from the cycles of rebirth.

verses.text:
यथा तु पुरुषो राजन्दीर्घमध्वानमास्थितः ।
क्वचित्क्वचिच्छ्रमात्स्थाता कुरुते वासमेव वा ॥

meaning.en: As a man on a long road stops to rest or takes lodging here and there from weariness,

verses.text:
एवं संसारपर्याये गर्भवासेषु भारत ।
कुर्वन्ति दुर्बुधा वासं मुच्यन्ते तत्र पण्डिताः ॥

meaning.en: so in the revolution of samsara the foolish make their dwelling in one womb after another, descendant of Bharata, while the wise are freed there.

verses.text:
तस्मादध्वानमेवैतमाहुः शास्त्रविदो जनाः ।
यत्तु संसारगहनं वनमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Therefore those who know the scriptures call this a road, and what the thoughtful call the thicket of samsara is the forest.

verses.text:
सोऽयं लोकसमावर्तो मर्त्यानां भरतर्षभ ।
चराणां स्थावराणां च गृध्येत्तत्र न पण्डितः ॥

meaning.en: This is the whirl of the world of mortals, best of the Bharatas, among moving and unmoving things. A wise man would not cling to it.

verses.text:
शारीरा मानसाश्चैव मर्त्यानां ये तु व्याधयः ।
प्रत्यक्षाश्च परोक्षाश्च ते व्यालाः कथिता बुधैः ॥

meaning.en: The diseases of mortals, bodily and mental, visible and invisible, are called the beasts by the wise.

verses.text:
क्लिश्यमानाश्च तैर्नित्यं हन्यमानाश्च भारत ।
स्वकर्मभिर्महाव्यालैर्नोद्विजन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: Constantly tormented and struck by these great beasts born of their own deeds, those of small understanding are still not alarmed.

verses.text:
अथापि तैर्विमुच्येत व्याधिभिः पुरुषो नृप ।
आवृणोत्येव तं पश्चाज्जरा रूपविनाशिनी ॥

meaning.en: Even if a man is freed from those diseases, king, old age, destroyer of beauty, afterward covers him.

verses.text:
शब्दरूपरसस्पर्शैर्गन्धैश्च विविधैरपि ।
मज्जमानं महापङ्के निरालम्बे समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: He sinks on every side into a great mire with no support, made of sounds, forms, tastes, touches and the many smells.

verses.text:
संवत्सरर्तवो मासाः पक्षाहोरात्रसंधयः ।
क्रमेणास्य प्रलुम्पन्ति रूपमायुस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: The years, seasons, months, fortnights, and the junctures of day and night in turn rob him of his beauty and his lifespan.

verses.text:
एते कालस्य निधयो नैताञ्जानन्ति दुर्बुधाः ।
अत्राभिलिखितान्याहुः सर्वभूतानि कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: These are the storehouses of Time, which the foolish do not know. All beings, they say, are inscribed here according to their deeds.

verses.text:
रथं शरीरं भूतानां सत्त्वमाहुस्तु सारथिम् ।
इन्द्रियाणि हयानाहुः कर्म बुद्धिश्च रश्मयः ॥

meaning.en: They call the body the chariot of beings, the sattva the charioteer, the senses the horses, and action and intellect the reins.

verses.text:
तेषां हयानां यो वेगं धावतामनुधावति ।
स तु संसारचक्रेऽस्मिंश्चक्रवत्परिवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: He who runs after the speed of those running horses turns round like a wheel on the wheel of samsara.

verses.text:
यस्तान्यमयते बुद्ध्या स यन्ता न निवर्तते ।
याम्यमाहू रथं ह्येनं मुह्यन्ते येन दुर्बुधाः ॥

meaning.en: He who holds them in check with his mind is the true driver and does not return. They call this chariot Yama's, by which the foolish are bewildered.

verses.text:
स चैतत्प्राप्नुते राजन्यत्त्वं प्राप्तो नराधिप ।
राज्यनाशं सुहृन्नाशं सुतनाशं च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Such a man meets what you have met, lord of men: the loss of the kingdom, the loss of friends, the loss of sons, descendant of Bharata.

verses.text:
अनुतर्षुलमेवैतद्दुःखं भवति भारत ।
साधुः परमदुःखानां दुःखभैषज्यमाचरेत् ॥

meaning.en: This sorrow is rooted in craving. A good man should apply the medicine for the sorest sorrows.

verses.text:
न विक्रमो न चाप्यर्थो न मित्रं न सुहृज्जनः ।
तथोन्मोचयते दुःखाद्यथात्मा स्थिरसंयमः ॥

meaning.en: Neither valor, nor wealth, nor friend, nor kinsman frees one from sorrow as a self steady in restraint does.

verses.text:
तस्मान्मैत्रं समास्थाय शीलमापद्य भारत ।
दमस्त्यागोऽप्रमादश्च ते त्रयो ब्रह्मणो हयाः ॥

meaning.en: Therefore, descendant of Bharata, adopt friendliness and good conduct. Self-control, renunciation and heedfulness are the three horses of Brahman.

verses.text:
शीलरश्मिसमायुक्ते स्थितो यो मानसे रथे ।
त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं राजन्ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Whoever stands in the chariot of the mind, equipped with the reins of good conduct, casts off the fear of death, king, and goes to the world of Brahma.
